b4/host/b4_ff_mapping.py.note: the certificate mapping of one site, read from gate_runs/run_2026_08_05_ff/certificate.json and held to its specimen pairs; the project's bit readings (plan section 2) checked against the certificate, never inferred from names.

b4/host/b4_ff_model.py.note: the simulated fabric: configuration + stimulus -> observation trace under a mapping and a hypothesis passed in separately; starts every observation from nothing; fixtures truth / permuted / dropout and the six hypothesis swaps.

b4/hypothesis/ff_behaviour_v0.1.json.note: status unverified; sources by kind — the vendor's UNISIM models by root + path + sha256 + the lines adopted, the certificate by path + sha256, the project's decode assumptions; the eleven behaviour flags; valid_configuration / applicable_semantics / observation_context kept apart.

b4/tests/test_b4_ff_model.py.note: every expected trace derived by hand from the hypothesis's adopted lines, never by running the model.
